posts.name: DeadBeat
posts.message:
We got rid of the email address. It cost money every month and nobody ever wrote to it, which is a bad combination even for us.

This is cheaper and has more thumbtacks.

posts.name: The Management
posts.message:
RULES OF THE BOARD:
1. Write something.
2. We read it eventually.
3. We answer some of them.
4. Nothing comes down unless it's mean or it's trying to sell us solar panels.
There was a fifth rule. We forgot it.

posts.name: Kev
posts.message: I play bass. Not well. I have my own amp and a van that starts most of the time.

reply.text: The van is the part we're interested in.

posts.name: Anonymous
posts.message: Do we exist? Asking because of the song. Also asking generally.

posts.name: Marcy from down the road
posts.message: Your shed was making noise until 2am on Tuesday. I'm not complaining. I'm just saying that I know it was you.

reply.text: That was a Tuesday? We had it down as a Saturday. Sorry Marcy. We'll be louder on a more appropriate night.

posts.name: Gord
posts.message: Saw you two in a garage in 1994. I think. There was definitely a garage. There was definitely whiskey. Were you the band, or were you the other guys sitting on the washing machine?

reply.text: We were the other guys. The band was worse.
